description:
Activate Endrider Catalyzer by tapping it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Endrider Catalyzer.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
